raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-16 rollout, v2 collector rows carry UTC txn_ts while legacy rows carry America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions casts them as if they were the same. v2 evening sales (18:00-22:41 Chicago) therefore land on the next date at 00:00-04:41, which explains the 41-row 01-19 and the 00:00-06:00 alerts. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago restores the original meaning.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH norm AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM norm;"}}
